# Review - PR 481 @ 881f4525d2ee7159af1758b1af152e31ff22c81e

Independent review by a Claude Opus helper (owner-authorized 2026-09-17); no author, fixer or prior reviewer context reused. Trusted prompt, persona and policy ref: 57798477c56b16b99282a4a056b8af66f3799185. Nine files, +821/-107 against merge base 1bee61396c7014e76a874f487f35068debce5f04 on `main`: the retained `sorry` in the complex X-factor removal is discharged with a new complex Cauchy--Schwarz module, the real-part analogue on the same auxiliary law is kept under an explicitly qualified name, the two estimates now share one factored measurement setup and one deficit lemma, and the blueprint and paper-gap note are restated accordingly.

## Findings

- none

## Review

Policy read from `github/main` at 57798477: `local/personas/reviewer.md`, `local/personas/prose-reviewer.md`, `local/protocols/review.md`, `docs/CONTRIBUTING.md` §5, `docs/mathematical_language.md` and the Proof Integrity and Faithful Formalization sections of `AGENTS.md`. The PR base is `main`; the worktree HEAD equals the published head 881f4525, so I read the diff and the files at that sha.

Prior findings. Round 4 (review 5235186726 @ 2b380072) left four unchecked. All four are resolved at this head, and I verified each against the PR-own change (`git diff $(git merge-base github/main <head>) <head>`) rather than against the fixer's description. F1, the two duplicate public wrappers: the PR no longer declares them; `MIPStarRE/QPBT/Combining/Claims.lean:754` and `:780` are the pre-existing `@[deprecated] alias` lines inherited from the merge base (they are context, not additions, in the main-relative diff), and the blueprint links at `ch15_qpbt_combining.tex:2320` and `:2410` point at `subline_replace_by_ordered_product_re_direct` / `subline_Z_term_near_one_re_direct`. F2, the roughly 85 duplicated lines of measurement setup: the shared data is now five private definitions `removeXLaw`, `removeXLine`, `removeXPointX`, `removeXPointZ`, `removeXPointZX` (`Claims.lean:296-339`), three private side-condition lemmas (`:341-372`), and one private quantitative lemma `exists_removeX_sqrt_deficit_le` (`:375`); the real-part theorem (`:448`) and the complex theorem (`:582`) both open with `obtain ... := exists_removeX_sqrt_deficit_le` and then differ only in the Cauchy--Schwarz estimate applied -- `abs_overlap_gap_le_sqrt_one_sub_of_isProj'` versus the new `norm_overlap_gap_le_sqrt_one_sub_of_isProj` -- and in the rewriting into their own statement shape. F3, the five duplicated certified support nodes: `git grep` for `lem:claim-17-1-direct-real`, `def:combined-line-measurement`, `lem:combined-line-measurement-x-marginal`, `lem:concrete-x-overlap-deficit` and `lem:claim-17-3-direct-real` at this head returns nothing; the `A_{ZX}`/`A_Z` abbreviations survive as an ordinary paragraph before `lem:claim-17-2-direct-real` (`ch15_qpbt_combining.tex:2854-2870`), and the only new nodes in the chapter are `lem:qld-sublines-direct` (`:2046`) and `lem:claim-17-2-direct-real` (`:2872`). F4, the two `\leanok` proofs of `lem:qld-4-10`: the PR no longer touches that lemma's proof block at all; the added proof and the retitled alternative-envelope proof are gone from the main-relative diff, and `lem:qld-4-10` (`:852`) carries exactly one certified proof, inherited from the base.

Proof integrity. No `sorry`, `admit`, `axiom` or `native_decide` occurs in the six touched Lean files at this head, and none occurs in the modules `Claims.lean` imports along the load-bearing route (`Lines/ConcreteXDeficit.lean`, `Lines/CombinedMeasurement.lean`, `OverlapGap.lean`, `SubLineZDeficit.lean`, `OrderedPoints.lean`, `ErrorBounds.lean`). The statement of `subline_remove_X_factor_direct` is untouched by the diff -- the hunk replaces the single line `sorry` by a proof and leaves the signature lines as context -- so nothing was weakened to make it pass. The new complex helpers add no conclusion-shaped input: `norm_weighted_sum_inner_le_sqrt_mul_sqrt` (`ComplexOverlapGap.lean:23`) assumes only positivity of the weighting family, and `norm_overlap_gap_le_sqrt_one_sub_of_isProj` (`:83`) assumes only projectivity of `B` and `C`, commutation with the effects of `A`, the factorization `CB = C * B`, a probability law and a unit state; its route (adjoint move on `C`, complex Cauchy--Schwarz, `avgOver_sum_stateQForm_mul_le_one`, `sum_stateQForm_effect_eq_one`) mirrors the real estimate already in `OverlapGap.lean` and reuses that module's lemmas instead of re-proving them. I grepped `github/main` before accepting the two new public lemmas: only the `abs_*`/real forms exist there, so these are genuine complex analogues, not duplicates. I re-elaborated `MIPStarRE/QPBT/Combining/ComplexOverlapGap.lean` and `MIPStarRE/QPBT/Combining/Claims.lean` with `lake env lean` in the PR worktree at 881f4525; both returned rc 0 with no diagnostics.

Faithfulness. Paper Claim 17-2 (`references/qpbt-paper/14_analysis_of_the_pauli_basis_test.tex:1168-1201`, with `T` the X-Z-X sandwich defined at lines 942--949) bounds the difference between the ordered `M^{Z} M^{X}` average and the `M^{Z}` average by `m \delta_\Line^{1/2}`, via Cauchy--Schwarz against the X-overlap deficit, which the paper's own argument bounds by `O(m^2 \delta_\Line)`. The proved Lean conclusion keeps the factor order, the placements `AA'` / `BA''`, and the error `C m \delta_\Line^{1/2}` obtained as `sqrt(K m^2 \delta_\Line)` from `exists_concreteXPointOverlap_deficit_le`; the complex version keeps the modulus, so the scope restriction is now only the carrier (`SubLineWitness`, the directly indexed law) and the `Option`-completed evaluations. That restriction is recorded where the policy requires it: `lem:claim-17-1` (`:2667`), `lem:claim-17-2` (`:2723`), `lem:claim-17-3` (`:2796`) and `lem:qld-sublines` (`:1835`) all keep `\notready` with no `\lean` or `\leanok`, and the certified entries are the explicitly formalization-only `lem:claim-17-2-direct`, `lem:claim-17-2-direct-real` and `lem:qld-sublines-direct`. The new public theorem `subline_remove_X_factor_re_direct` and the two complex helpers carry docstrings with paper-mirror locators and blueprint labels, per `AGENTS.md` (Documentation) and CONTRIBUTING §5.8--§5.9; the removal of the blueprint line range in `Points/PlacementSupport.lean:17` follows the same rule.

Prose. The new `lem:claim-17-2-direct` proof (`:2400-2406`) and `lem:claim-17-2-direct-real` with its proof (`:2872-2898`) state exactly what the Lean theorems prove, with the correct constant `C = \sqrt K` and the `K m^2 \delta_\Line` deficit; the closing paragraph (`:2900-2906`) says explicitly that none of the three source-labelled claims is certified by these auxiliary entries, which matches the `\notready` state above. The `\uses` sets resolve to existing nodes and match the Lean dependencies. The `SubLineUniform.lean` and `ch15_qpbt_combining.tex:2309-2315` fiber corrections are mathematically right: for `v \ne 0` the fiber of `(u,t) \mapsto L_v(u) + t v` over a point fixes both the canonical representative and `t` while `u` ranges over a coset of `span(v)`, and for `v = 0` the point is `u` and `t` is free -- `q` elements either way, which is the count the lemma needs. The paper-gap note now classifies the scalar step as proved and keeps transport and `combined_line_measurement_consistency` open, with a statement-integrity section recording paper assumptions, Lean assumptions, conclusion and verdict as `AGENTS.md` requires. The `Fin n` index paragraph in `lem:qld-sublines-direct` is the sanctioned location for a notation deviation under `docs/mathematical_language.md` (Reference Notation And Terminology, location 3), not banned Lean jargon.

Exact-head CI: all nine `local-ci/*` contexts are success at 881f4525 (`local-ci/summary`: "all gating steps passed (278s)"), including `blueprint-sync`, `file-length`, `proof-debt` and `proof-evasion`.

Not checked: I did not run a full `lake build`, `leanblueprint web` or `lake exe checkdecls` (the build lock is machine-wide and CI covers them at this head), and I did not run `#print axioms` on the touched theorems, so transitive axiom cleanliness rests on the grep above plus the green `proof-debt`/`proof-evasion` gates. Two non-blocking observations I did not raise as findings: the dated audit `audits/2026-09-09_pr481-corrected-review-repair.md` describes the repair as of 52aa0088 and its Claim 17-2 row still records only the real-part Lean conclusion, while the current head also proves the complex-modulus one (the up-to-date statement-integrity record is in the paper-gap note); and the PR body's Description lists merge subjects rather than the head commit's content.

VERDICT: APPROVED (code=APPROVED, prose=APPROVED)
